status: declarative_obligations; executed by app/tests/test_search.py and test_search_integration.py (#25)

cases.name: profile-isolation
cases.given: Stored vectors exist for a profile other than the configured one, including the same dimension
cases.expected: Other-profile rows are never ranked; only the configured profile's vectors enter the semantic branch

cases.name: query-transform
cases.given: A query begins with a space or contains composed/decomposed Unicode
cases.expected: Preserve exact nonempty input bytes after the qualified prefix; do not silently normalize

cases.name: empty-query
cases.given: Empty or whitespace-only text with camera/date and optional numeric predicates
cases.expected: No embedding request; current eligible browsing/numeric results

cases.name: invalid-vector
cases.given: Wrong output count, dimension, nonfinite component, zero norm or failed normalization tolerance
cases.expected: Reject vector storage/eligibility; bounded job failure

cases.name: late-human-edit
cases.given: Embedding job starts before a human correction and returns afterward
cases.expected: CAS rejects current eligibility of old text; history may retain result

cases.name: evidence-revision
cases.given: Late telemetry changes measured evidence but unchanged visual-only evidence remains valid
cases.expected: Withdraw dependent synthesis docs; retain only independently valid visual docs

cases.name: outbox-crash
cases.given: Crash after metadata transaction but before queue acknowledgement
cases.expected: Replay idempotently; no old searchable revision is restored

cases.name: private-leak
cases.given: Favorite/note/operator/private-original fields exist in stored editorial state
cases.expected: Canonical document, public snippets and vectors never derive from private fields

cases.name: zero-rain-missing
cases.given: Predicate rain equals zero over missing or below-minimum-coverage measurements
cases.expected: No match; no implicit conversion of unknown to zero

cases.name: unit-equivalence
cases.given: Equivalent qualified thresholds expressed in mm/in or degC/degF
cases.expected: Same eligible set under canonical conversion and specified statistic

cases.name: clip-and-whole-segment
cases.given: A semantic clip hit has matching whole-video numeric aggregate
cases.expected: Show the whole-video measurement interval and clip precision separately

cases.name: fusion-and-collapse
cases.given: One video has many matched windows and another has one
cases.expected: Fuse deterministic branch ranks; max document per video, not sum of window scores

cases.name: inference-outage
cases.given: No compatible cached query vector and embedding unavailable
cases.expected: Labeled lexical fallback preserves all publication/revision/numeric/date/camera filters

cases.name: ann-underfill
cases.given: Strict predicates leave fewer than top_k candidates
cases.expected: Bounded scan/exact fallback or fewer hits; never remove filters

cases.name: shadow-correction-race
cases.given: Document correction lands during shadow generation backfill/activation
cases.expected: Catch up to watermark and serialize final activation; old text remains withdrawn
cases.obsolete: P10: no shadow generations or query-vector cache

cases.name: rollback-withdrawal
cases.given: Prior retained generation contains a now-invalid document
cases.expected: Rollback never restores eligibility; use current lexical fallback where vectors are absent
cases.obsolete: P10: no shadow generations or query-vector cache

cases.name: restore-without-model
cases.given: Restore metadata/profiles/full vectors while inference route is blocked
cases.expected: Stored-vector exact fixture search and lexical/typed queries work without re-embedding

cases.name: query-timeout
cases.given: Exact filtered scan exhausts its admitted statement/work budget
cases.expected: Explicit unavailable response, not empty-success or unbounded retry

cases.name: lexical-literal-operators
cases.given: Query contains punctuation, OR, negation or tsquery-style operators
cases.expected: Apply parameterized English plain-query semantics; never execute SQL/operators or claim semantic negation in lexical fallback

cases.name: lexical-no-terms
cases.given: Nonempty punctuation-only or all-stop-word query produces no lexical terms
cases.expected: With compatible semantic vector rank semantic branch only; otherwise empty lexical response with lexical_no_terms explanation, never numeric browse-all

cases.name: lexical-policy-revision
cases.given: Database image or dictionary changes lexical output
cases.expected: Retain old policy inventory; qualify and rebuild under new lexical revision before activation, with current-eligibility checks

cases.name: cumulative-query-budget
cases.given: Individually short SQL statements collectively exhaust the request SQL allowance
cases.expected: Cancel/rollback, return unavailable, verify connection terminal state before reuse; never reset budget per statement

cases.name: query-cache-pressure
cases.given: Cache exceeds entry/byte cap or reaches absolute expiry while requests remain frequent
cases.expected: Enforce deployment-wide 256-entry/8-MiB bound and 15-minute non-sliding TTL; reuse only exact transformed hash/profile and rerun current filters
cases.obsolete: P10: no shadow generations or query-vector cache

cases.name: replica-and-timeout-occupancy
cases.given: Replica rollout or caller timeout occurs with queued SQL and remote embedding still running
cases.expected: Do not multiply deployment limits or release uncertain backend occupancy; preserve separate SQL/model admission and bounded degraded fallback
